g.title: Sheet.62
g.desc: A router only reads the Layer 2 and Layer 3 headers of packet...
g.text: A router only reads the Layer 2 and Layer 3 headers of packets to make forwarding decisions (hence “it works at layer 3”).

g.title: Sheet.63
g.desc: The router doesn’t read packet data, just like the post offic...
g.text: The router doesn’t read packet data, just like the post office doesn’t read a letter’s content, just delivers it.
